label: Apparel Designer
summary: Two Apparel Resumes against Blockchain and Arts.
job_description:
We are hiring an Apparel Designer for the boyswear licensed-brands line, taking each season from concept sketches through fit sessions to handover.

What we need:
- 3+ years apparel design experience
- Apparel product development
- Quality and specification review

The original posting also asked for the following, which this demo does not gate on: Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite; Experience creating detailed tech packs; Strong trend research and forecasting skills; Ability to manage global factory relationships; Portfolio of boyswear or kidswear designs.
